title.zh-CN: 呼吸困难、血痰与双腿胀痛 · 30岁女性
title.en: Dyspnoea, blood-streaked sputum and painful legs · woman aged 30

summary.zh-CN: 多部位血栓与血小板减少及延长APTT并存，需要区分实验室抗凝现象和体内血栓风险。
summary.en: Multiple thromboses coexist with thrombocytopenia and prolonged APTT, requiring distinction between laboratory anticoagulant effects and clinical thrombosis.

provenance.citation: 王芮琦, 董春玲, 吴艳峰, 徐伟, 张捷. 以肺动静脉栓塞为首发表现的原发性抗磷脂抗体综合征一例. 中华结核和呼吸杂志. 2013;36(12):988-989. doi:10.3760/cma.j.issn.1001-0939.2013.12.035.

notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

notes.en: AI-assisted editorial check against the cited authorities, not licensed-clinician review. Rare presentations and source regimens still require specialist confirmation.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 区分APTT体外延长与体内血栓风险。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish prolonged in-vitro APTT from in-vivo thrombosis risk.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用产科史补全获得性血栓倾向线索。
learningOutcomes.en: Use obstetric history to extend acquired-thrombophilia assessment.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 咳嗽气短胸痛半个月，加重3天
chiefComplaint.en: Two weeks of cough, breathlessness and chest pain, worse for three days

triageNote.zh-CN: 活动后气短、偶有血痰，伴双下肢胀痛水肿。
triageNote.en: Exertional dyspnoea and occasional blood-streaked sputum with painful swollen legs.

prompt.zh-CN: 延长APTT和血小板减少应怎样放回血栓证据中？
prompt.en: How should prolonged APTT and thrombocytopenia be interpreted alongside thrombosis?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 考虑APS等获得性血栓倾向，不能因APTT长排除血栓
text.en: Consider acquired thrombophilia such as APS; prolonged APTT does not exclude thrombosis

feedback.zh-CN: 已存在影像血栓和妊娠线索。
feedback.en: Imaging-confirmed clots and obstetric clues are present.

text.zh-CN: APTT长说明只能出血、不可能血栓
text.en: Long APTT means only bleeding, never thrombosis

feedback.zh-CN: 实验室现象与体内风险并非简单相同。
feedback.en: Laboratory effects and in-vivo risk are not identical.

text.zh-CN: 肺听诊清就排除肺栓塞
text.en: Clear lungs exclude pulmonary embolism

feedback.zh-CN: 听诊正常不能推翻血管影像。
feedback.en: Normal auscultation does not negate vascular imaging.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 高度怀疑APS，但需确认持续抗体及临床细节
text.en: APS is strongly suspected but persistence and clinical details need verification

feedback.zh-CN: 单次阳性不能冒充完整分类资料。
feedback.en: One positive result is not complete classification evidence.

text.zh-CN: 一个aCL结果已满足所有现代分类要求
text.en: One aCL result satisfies every contemporary classification requirement

feedback.zh-CN: 缺同型、持续性和完整评分资料。
feedback.en: Isotype, persistence and complete scoring data are absent.

text.zh-CN: ANA阴性可排除原发APS
text.en: Negative ANA excludes primary APS

feedback.en: Primary APS does not require ANA positivity.

prompt.zh-CN: 如何安排抗凝与后续评估？
prompt.en: How should anticoagulation and follow-up be organised?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 血液及相关团队个体化抗凝，结合血小板出血风险、抗体复测和妊娠计划
text.en: Specialists should individualise anticoagulation with platelet/bleeding review, repeat antibodies and pregnancy planning

feedback.zh-CN: 不能由本例推出所有APS需要激素或相同抗凝药。
feedback.en: This report does not establish steroids or one anticoagulant for every APS patient.

text.zh-CN: 血小板低就一律不给抗凝
text.en: Low platelets always prohibit anticoagulation

feedback.zh-CN: 需权衡实际血栓和出血风险。
feedback.en: Actual thrombotic and bleeding risks require balancing.

text.zh-CN: 只用激素即可替代血栓治疗
text.en: Steroids alone replace thrombosis treatment

feedback.zh-CN: 免疫相关标签不能取代抗栓评估。
feedback.en: An immune label does not replace antithrombotic assessment.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：区分APTT体外延长与体内血栓风险。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：抗体同型和持续性、LA/抗β2GPI、死胎孕周及完整肺静脉影像复核。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: Distinguish prolonged in-vitro APTT from in-vivo thrombosis risk. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: Antibody isotype/persistence, LA/anti-beta2GPI, stillbirth gestation and independent pulmonary venous imaging review. Check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

teachingPoints.en: Explain the gap between one aCL result and complete APS evidence.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 抗体同型和持续性、LA/抗β2GPI、死胎孕周及完整肺静脉影像复核。
unknowns.en: Antibody isotype/persistence, LA/anti-beta2GPI, stillbirth gestation and independent pulmonary venous imaging review.

references: 王芮琦, 董春玲, 吴艳峰, 徐伟, 张捷. 以肺动静脉栓塞为首发表现的原发性抗磷脂抗体综合征一例. 中华结核和呼吸杂志. 2013;36(12):988-989. doi:10.3760/cma.j.issn.1001-0939.2013.12.035.

notice.zh-CN: 教学脚本评估，并非经过验证的能力评分。
notice.en: A teaching-script measure, not a validated competency score.

unknowns.en: Antibody isotype/persistence, LA/anti-beta2GPI, stillbirth gestation and independent pulmonary venous imaging review.

testUtterances.text: 气短多久了，活动和休息时有什么不同？
How long has breathlessness lasted, and how do activity and rest affect it?
咳嗽时有没有血痰，最近加重吗？
Is there blood in sputum, and has it worsened recently?
胸痛是什么感觉，和呼吸有关系吗？
What does chest pain feel like, and does breathing affect it?
咳嗽或活动会让胸痛加重吗？
Does coughing or activity worsen the pain?
腿痛和肿胀什么时候出现？
When did leg pain and swelling start?
两条腿都有胀痛吗？
Are both legs aching?
以前怀孕有过死胎或流产吗？
Have previous pregnancies involved stillbirth or miscarriage?
那次妊娠的孕周有记录吗？
Is the gestation of that pregnancy recorded?
以前血小板低是何时发现的？
When was low platelet count previously found?
过去血小板减少怎么诊断的？
What diagnosis was given for earlier thrombocytopenia?
以前做过什么手术？
What operations were performed previously?
过去有没有手术住院经历？
Have there been previous surgical admissions?
有没有吸烟或饮酒？
Is there smoking or alcohol use?
烟酒的用量和时间有记录吗？
Are amounts and duration of smoking or alcohol recorded?
以前有没有妊娠结局方面的情况？
Could you describe any pregnancy outcome?
以前有没有药物过敏方面的情况？
Could you describe any medicine allergies?
以前有没有家族病史方面的情况？
Could you describe any family illnesses?
以前有没有日常用药清单方面的情况？
Could you describe any regular medicines?
